meta.title: Employee Verification Portal — Getmeds
meta.description: Verify whether someone contacting you is a genuine Getmeds Philippines employee before sharing personal information or making any payment.

hero.heading: Employee Verification
hero.description: Protecting our clients and partners. Enter an employee ID, email address, or phone number to verify their current employment status with Getmeds Philippines.

instructions: Enter the full name, official email, or employee ID of the representative.
Click verify to query our live authorized employee registry.
Only official Getmeds representatives with valid credentials will be confirmed.

support.notice: If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report immediately to our HR Security team.
